takeaway: A single, unauthenticated clinic user can manage owners and their pets, book visits for pets and look up veterinarians.

elements.name: Clinic user
elements.responsibility: The only role: no security dependency, login page or role checks exist, so every visitor can do everything (name chosen by us; the code does not name the role)

elements.name: Find an owner and their pets' visits
elements.responsibility: Search by last name, open owner page with pets and visit history

elements.name: Register a new owner
elements.responsibility: Create an owner with contact details

elements.name: Update owner or pet details
elements.responsibility: Edit an owner's contact data or a pet's name, birth date, type

elements.name: Register a pet
elements.responsibility: Add a pet (name unique per owner) to an owner

elements.name: Book a visit for a pet
elements.responsibility: Record a future visit with a description

elements.name: Look up veterinarians and their specialties

the goals each role can achieve

omitted.name: Manage veterinarians or specialties
omitted.reason: no create/update endpoint exists; vets come only from seed data (db/*/data.sql)
